lines.t: [atmospheric synth pads, wordless vocalizing in falsetto]
(Doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo)
[Verse 1]
I locked the doors, I drew the curtains tight
Chasing the shadow through the screen tonight
I gave up my worth for a moment of praise
Lost in the cycles of the modern ways
I built a prison, I forged a chain
Living a life full of hidden pain
How can it be? How can it be?
[Pre-Chorus]
The world demands that the sinner must pay
But You walked the road to take it away
The cross was mine, the guilt was real
You broke the chain
[Chorus]
I am Barabbas, but You took my place
Mercy, mercy
I was the prisoner, but You gave me grace
Free me, free me
The dark is pulling me down to the grave
But You are the only one powerful to save
I am Barabbas, but You took my place
Grace, grace
[Verse 2]
They count my mistakes and they look at my past
The judgment of man is a shadow that's cast
Caught in the trap of the places I've been
A modern woman with the secret sin
But thirty-nine lashes tore into Your skin
To pay for the war that is raging within
How can it be? How can it be?
[Pre-Chorus]
The world demands that the sinner must pay
But You walked the road to take it away
The cross was mine, the guilt was real
You broke the chain
[Chorus]
I am Barabbas, but You took my place
Mercy, mercy
I was the prisoner, but You gave me grace
Free me, free me
The dark is pulling me down to the grave
But You are the only one powerful to save
I am Barabbas, but You took my place
Grace, grace
[Bridge]
I am Barabbas, but You took my place
No more fighting, no more hiding
The prison walls fall free
Saved by grace
(Oh-oh-oh-oh)
[Outro]
[music fades to acoustic guitar and synth pads]
[Instrumental]
